description: This Java source file defines the ConceptComplex class, a subclass of Concept, which associates a ComplexObsHandler with a Concept in the OpenMRS core API. It includes constructors, a method to check if the concept is complex, and getter/setter for the handler property.

classes.name: ConceptComplex
classes.description: A subclass of Concept that associates a ComplexObsHandler with the Concept, used in handling complex observations within OpenMRS.
